title: Choose the desktop app’s visual world
question: Pick the interface language for the local Hide / Recover workflow, or re-roll for a fresh set.

options.label: Contact Sheet
options.lineage: photographic proof sheets and darkroom crop notes
options.thesis: Treat every encode as a careful before-and-after image proof, with the payload recorded in the margin.
options.viewport: A large image proof anchors the left while one disciplined task column on the right moves from image to payload to output.
options.risk: The photographic references become decorative if the preview and capacity readout do not drive the task.

raised.raise: Every processing state gains a redundant line pattern and explicit text, never color alone.
The current file remains visibly pinned in place through the entire operation.
Completed outputs remain as a visible receipt instead of disappearing into a toast.

options.label: Specimen Register
options.thesis: Each carrier image is a specimen with provenance, measured capacity, and a clear chain of handling.
options.viewport: A broad specimen panel sits beside a precise record form, with Hide and Recover as two ledger tabs.
options.risk: The strongest familiar fit for a careful local utility, but easier to make conventional than the assigned direction.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.lineage: film work prints and edit-bench select rails
options.thesis: The workflow becomes a short strip of pinned frames: source, payload, and finished proof.
options.viewport: A horizontal three-frame strip makes the operation visible at a glance, with the active frame flagged in orange.
options.case: Strong image-world recognition and clear progress, but less comfortable for long paths and error copy than Contact Sheet.
options.risk: Can feel like a media editor when the product only needs two focused operations.

options.label: Normalled Jackfield
options.thesis: Input and output paths connect as explicit signal routes.
options.viewport: Numbered lanes connect the carrier, payload, and destination.
options.case: Excellent state clarity, but it overstates the tool’s complexity and leans toward a hacker-console stereotype.
options.risk: Too technical for a two-task desktop utility.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Hide and Recover become two detachable processing coupons.
options.viewport: A two-coupon wallet shows the current task and its retained receipt.
options.case: The sequence is clear, but travel language does not belong to image steganography.
options.kept: Completed work stays visible as a receipt.

options.label: Generative Identity
options.thesis: The image’s byte pattern reseeds the interface accents.
options.viewport: A live mark changes as files are selected.
options.case: It dramatizes encoding but creates visual churn in a task that needs trust and repeatability.
options.kept: One coherent rule should govern every state change.

options.label: Industrial Labels
options.thesis: Literal labels make every file operation unmistakable.
options.viewport: Large literal zones label source, payload, and output.
options.case: Direct language helps clarity, but the aggressive styling mismatches a careful local tool.
options.kept: Controls use literal verbs and explicit outcomes.
options.risk: Visual urgency implies danger where calm is needed.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.thesis: Payload bytes are cut into visible image blocks and reassembled.
options.viewport: A carrier image opens into layered blocks around the task controls.
options.case: Memorable but materially less clear and less trustworthy than a photographic proofing world.
options.kept: The selected image should remain the dominant object, not a thumbnail.
options.risk: Surreal imagery competes with the actual file preview.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A conventional desktop utility with tabs, file pickers, a preview pane, and one primary action.
canonCard.viewport: Two tabs sit over a centered form and preview with familiar platform spacing.
canonCard.risk: Immediately understandable but visually indistinguishable from most file utilities.
